name: Pearson Edexcel international - iPrimary to International A Level (Year 1 to Year 13)

verification.notes: Draft: no Pearson Edexcel examiner or school reviewer has checked this pack. Source links: all seven URLs resolved to the named pages on 2026-10-21 (titles matched). What is a placeholder, not a claim: every percentage-to-grade band. Pearson sets grade boundaries for each qualification and each exam series after marking, so international_gcse_9_1, international_gcse_a_star_g and international_a_level are school defaults and are declared overridable (grading_scales.<code>.bands); a school must replace them with the board's boundaries for the session. What is structured but unverified: the International GCSE Mathematics A paper structure (two papers of 100 marks, half the qualification each) follows the published specification and was not re-read from it; International AS and A Level subjects declare no papers, and the International A Level Mathematics paper set is not modelled, because only the International GCSE papers and no A Level maxima were verified. The two International GCSE papers carry their 0.5 shares in component_policy.weights under MAT, and Mathematics declares international_gcse_9_1 at Y10-Y11 (the 4MA1 syllabus the modelled papers belong to). No board assessment is declared at Year 6 or Year 9: the iPrimary and iLowerSecondary assessments are optional school assessments, and calling them national would overclaim. UCAS: the A Level tariff is per grade, not per grade and subject: A* 56, A 48, B 40, C 32, D 24, E 16, U 0, summed over the qualifications taken. The tariff table is rendered client-side and was not read off the live page, so the figures come from spec 03 Appendix C; no AS or International GCSE tariff is modelled. Grade codes are the printed grades, so A* is the band code and the label repeats it. Calendar: the pack declares both the northern (August) and the southern (January) academic year as named variants, northern by default. Locale: English only; other languages are a translation task, not a pack version.
